title: White House asks the congressman to praise the release

tellings.quote: And then they they called and said, you know, hey, can you be can you say some positive things about the president's release tomorrow?

plain: In 2026, the day before the president put out a release of information, the White House called a congressman and asked him to say some positive things about it, according to that congressman, Eric Burlison. Burlison tells Michels this happened to him directly, in the words "can you say some positive things about the president's release tomorrow?" He tells it to show how the government tried to shape the public reaction to what it was releasing.
